evidence: Receiving online DO: 12.4 mg/L at 46h, 8.37 at 46.2h, 6.95 at 51.8h, monotone decline over last ~6h and below all source dips (~7.4-8.2 mg/L at ~46-48h in source-1/2/3).

Delayed assays: receiving P 3.159 g/L at 47.8h (assay t=51.8h) vs source ~5.3-5.5 g/L at same elapsed time, confirming the receiving process is in a heavier, higher-demand phase than source reference.
Forward model KEEP: post-decision min DO 2.585 mg/L, product 287.7 kg; sensitivity min 1.873 mg/L (4/5 feasible members).
Forward model combined (0.8 feed, 1.15 air): min DO 3.309 mg/L, product 598.1 kg; sensitivity min 2.596 mg/L, 5/5 feasible members.

Forward model increase_air alone: min DO 2.470 mg/L, product 320.9 kg — weaker margin than combined; strong feed reduction alone sacrifices oxygen-supporting growth and was not needed. No oxygen-constraint violation predicted under combined; stop rejected since feasible operating plans exist.
args.rationale: At decision time (52 h), the receiving online DO has fallen from ~8.4 to ~6.95 mg/L over the last ~6 h — a steeper and deeper excursion than any of the three source reference batches at comparable elapsed times (source dips recovered above ~9 within a few hours, but receiving is already below the source minimum and still descending). The nominal forward model classifies KEEP as feasible (post-decision min DO 2.59 mg/L) but with only a ~0.6 mg/L margin, and one member of its (non-probabilistic) sensitivity set drops to 1.87 mg/L, i.e., a centrally thin margin near the hard 2.0 mg/L limit. The combined intervention (feed ×0.8, air ×1.15) both raises DO margin (central min DO 3.31 mg/L; sensitivity range 2.60–5.63, all 5 members feasible) and roughly doubles retained product mass (598 kg vs 288 kg under KEEP, 321 kg under increase_air alone) because the reduced load and increased aeration let production continue past the peak-demand window. increase_air alone leaves a thinner DO margin (2.47 mg/L central); stop is unnecessary since a supported feasible plan exists. Combined is the only action that is supported as feasible across its full sensitivity range while retaining maximum product mass.
args.uncertainty: The forward model is source-calibrated and imperfect; the receiving process demonstrably differs from source (its current DO excursion is deeper than any source batch at the same age, and delayed assays show the receiving P trajectory lags source). The 4h-turnaround extra assay could refine the growth/oxygen-demand estimate, but the DO margin under combined is large (central 3.31 mg/L, worst sensitivity member 2.60 mg/L) and the receiving DO is currently 6.95 mg/L with ~0.25 mg/L/h decline, so waiting or acting without it is low-risk. Residual risk: an unexpectedly prolonged demand spike beyond model horizon; the model's sensitivity set is not a probability distribution and cannot guarantee the hidden realization, so no physical safety is established. This is a simulation recommendation, not equipment execution.
